metadata.description: Spouse of Enel, the third Elf-father. She was awakened by Enel at Cuiviénen during the Years of the Trees. Together with Enel and their 72 companions, they became the Nelyar, the largest clan of Elves. Her descendants include the Teleri, Sindar, and Lindar. Ancestor of Elwë (Thingol) and Olwë. Little else is known of her life.
